conditions.displayName: An index run failed, fell behind, or Cloud Scheduler couldn't run it

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="foto-log-web" AND severity>=ERROR AND (jsonPayload.message="Index tick: the index is behind Jetstream" OR jsonPayload.message="Index tick failed")) OR (resource.type="cloud_scheduler_job" AND resource.labels.job_id="foto-log-index-tick" AND severity>=ERROR)

documentation.content: An index run (Cloud Scheduler job foto-log-index-tick, every 3 minutes) failed. Either it crashed (`Index tick failed`), the index is more than 15 minutes behind Jetstream (`Index tick: the index is behind Jetstream`), or Cloud Scheduler's attempt failed (a 401 means the job's token no longer matches INDEX_TICK_SECRET; a deadline error means a run took over 300 seconds). The log entry's `catchUp` field shows the Jetstream host, why the run stopped, and the lag. At most one email an hour. See docs/infra.md.
